description: Computes the split payment (scissione dei pagamenti) for supplies to the Italian Public Administration (art. 17-ter DPR 633/72): the supplier invoices taxable amount + VAT but collects from the PA ONLY the taxable amount, while the PA pays the VAT directly to the Treasury. Returns the two amounts separately, the cash-flow impact for the supplier and the FatturaPA instructions (EsigibilitaIVA=S; the N6 Natura codes are NOT used, they belong to the reverse charge only). It does NOT apply to self-employed fee invoices with withholding tax (art. 17-ter c. 1-sexies): for a professional use calc_iva with con_ritenuta. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

aliquota_iva.description: VAT rate shown on the invoice (default 22).

imponibile.description: Taxable amount of the supply to the PA in EUR.

name: calc_split_payment
title: Split payment (scissione dei pagamenti)
